none: PAS CAM-F55EF6: Copper-alloy Nummus Roman Coin of Helena
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ FL IVL HELENAE AVG ; R/ PAX PVBLICA

A copper-alloy nummus of Helena. Mint is Trier, 337-340, Reece period 17. Obverse shows draped bust right. Obverse legend reads FL IVL HELENAE AVG. Reverse shows Pax standing left, holding branch and sceptre. Reverse legend reads PAX PVBLICA. Reverse fields and exergue read: -//(.TRS)[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.62g, diameter is 15.90mm. See RIC VIII, p.143,…
